paymentAgreementId.description: Payment Agreement Id that can be used with the Payment Initiation API or batch.  This Id will only be valid once the payer has completed the one-time UX experience on the `sessionUrl` successfully.

sessionUrl.description: Url link to a one-time UX experience that enables payers to create and approve a PayTo Agreement.  Attach encoded `redirectURL` and `cancelRedirectURL` as query parameters. If the `redirectURL` is invoked,  then the `paymentAgreementId` can be used later to take payments. If `cancelRedirectURL` is invoked a new `sessionUrl` must be generated for the payer to try again.
